captions.detailed: A compact, palm-sized camcorder with an all-black matte finish. It features a main rectangular body with rounded edges, a short front-facing cylindrical lens barrel, a rounded side handgrip, and a flat side screen panel. The lens is trimmed with a textured gray ring that rotates continuously, while the side monitor is hinged to swing outward, and a small rectangular port flap on the lower side rotates along its bottom edge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact handheld camcorder with a rounded body, a front lens barrel, a side handgrip, and a flip-out monitor. Ensure there are articulations for a rotating lens ring, a swing-out side monitor, and a hinged port cover on the side wall.
captions.factory: Construct the main camcorder body using a filleted box primitive, adding a top accessory shoe. Model the lens barrel as a cylinder, and create a textured lens ring using a cylinder with polar-patterned rectangular cuts. Build the side handgrip and the rectangular monitor panel using filleted boxes. Define the assembly with three joints: a continuous rotational joint for the lens ring, a revolute joint on a vertical axis for the flip-out side monitor, and a revolute joint on a horizontal axis for the bottom port cover.
